rules.rationale: This is the base equation defining fibFrom: for a nonpositive iteration count, the named summary returns its first accumulator.
This is the recursive equation defining fibFrom by one Fibonacci accumulator transition and a decremented positive iteration count.

This simplification rule asserts an additional universal integer-arithmetic identity used to close the loop proof; Stage 1 compiles the rule before every kprove run and contains no prior proof of its exact statement in a module without the rule.
